title: geranium jaekelae
intro: Geranium jaekelae, commonly known as the West Indian geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving stress and anxiety, and promoting skin health. The therapeutic actions of Geranium jaekelae include acting as a nervine, astringent, and anti-inflammatory, which can help to calm the nervous system, tone the skin, and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and geranic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
